title: Local iscsi_lock evidence can be refuted by a cross-file unlock caller
query: iscsi lock unlock cross file lifecycle

locator.excerpt: iscsi_lock local acquisition and iscsi_unlock in a different caller

summary: A local function containing iscsi_lock without a visible unlock is an investigation lead only. The unlock may be in a helper or a caller in another file after the protected operation.
content: Counterexample history: a review saw iscsi_lock in one function and no matching unlock in that function. Cross-file call tracing showed the operation returned to a caller that invoked iscsi_unlock after the protected work. The local-only pattern was therefore insufficient evidence for a resource leak conclusion.
exclusions: a local lock without a visible unlock is not a confirmed leak
